result.reason: The redline gives Licensee the required affiliate/successor assignment rights and removes Licensor’s change-of-control termination right. However, it neither requires Licensee consent for assignments by Licensor nor prohibits assignment by Licensor to a Licensee competitor, so it fails both the preferred position and the mutual fallback. It also leaves intact Licensor’s right of first refusal over mergers and asset sales, which may materially constrain the transactions the assignment language is intended to permit. The margin comment cannot cure these operative omissions. Drafting quality is further reduced by the unresolved run-on sentence/cross-reference in the assignment provision and existing errors in the ROFR language.
